name: Asahi Yukizai Corporation
summary: Asahi Yukizai Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the pipe and fittings system, resin, and water treatment and resource development businesses in Japan, the United States, and internationally. It offers manual and automatic valves, as well as plastic pipes and fittings under the ASAHIAV brand; plastic valves under the Dymatrix brand; flow control systems under the Falconics brand; mixers under the Mixworx brand; and engineering services, including tank design and manufacturing, resin processed product manufacturing, structural and piping stress analysis, and supervisor dispatch, as well as piping design and installation, prefabrication, and checks.
